name: sync-sherpa-onnx

# Daily check for new k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx releases. When upstream is newer
# than the pinned default in scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh, run the bump
# script and open a PR. Manual runs accept an explicit version override.
#
# Note: PRs created with the default GITHUB_TOKEN do NOT trigger other
# workflows (CI, release, etc.). To get full CI on the bump PR, store a
# fine-grained PAT with `pull-requests: write` + `contents: write` as a
# repo secret named SYNC_PR_TOKEN; the workflow will pick it up below.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'  # 03:17 UTC, off the :00/:30 storm
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Override target sherpa-onnx version (no leading v). Empty = use upstream latest.'
        required: false
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: sync-sherpa-onnx
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Resolve target version
        id: target
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          OVERRIDE: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ -n "${OVERRIDE}" ]]; then
            target="${OVERRIDE}"
          else
            target="$(gh api repos/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/latest --jq .tag_name | sed 's/^v//')"
          fi
          # shellcheck source=scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh
          source ./scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh
          current="${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION}"
          echo "current=${current}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "target=${target}"   >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          if [[ "${current}" == "${target}" ]]; then
            echo "skip=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
            echo "Already pinned at v${target}, nothing to do." >&2
          fi

      - name: Bump pinned version
        if: steps.target.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: bash scripts/bump-sherpa-onnx.sh "${{ steps.target.outputs.target }}"

      - name: Install Nix
        if: steps.target.outputs.skip != 'true'
        uses: DeterminateSystems/nix-installer-action@v18

      - name: Update flake.lock sherpa-onnx input
        if: steps.target.outputs.skip != 'true'
        # Best-effort: this only follows whatever revision
        # xifan2333/sherpa-onnx-flake currently points to. If that flake
        # repo has not been bumped yet, flake.lock will not pick up the
        # new upstream version on the NixOS side until it is.
        run: nix flake update sherpa-onnx

      - name: Open PR
        if: steps.target.outputs.skip != 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.SYNC_PR_TOKEN || github.token }}
          branch: chore/sherpa-onnx-${{ steps.target.outputs.target }}
          delete-branch: true
          commit-message: |
            chore(deps): bump sherpa-onnx to v${{ steps.target.outputs.target }}
          title: 'chore(deps): bump sherpa-onnx to v${{ steps.target.outputs.target }}'
          body: |
            Auto-generated by `.github/workflows/sync-sherpa-onnx.yml`.

            - previous: `v${{ steps.target.outputs.current }}`
            - new:      `v${{ steps.target.outputs.target }}`
            - upstream release: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/v${{ steps.target.outputs.target }}

            Updated files:
            - `scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh`
            - `packaging/flatpak/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.Addon.Vinput.yaml`
            - `packaging/flatpak/ci-manifest.yaml`
            - `flake.lock` (best-effort `nix flake update sherpa-onnx`)

            Please review the upstream changelog before merging — sherpa-onnx ABI
            and model-format changes ride along with this bump.

            **NixOS note**: the actual sherpa-onnx version on NixOS is decided by
            [`xifan2333/sherpa-onnx-flake`](https://github.com/xifan2333/sherpa-onnx-flake).
            If `flake.lock` did not pick up `v${{ steps.target.outputs.target }}`, that
            repo needs to be bumped first.
          labels: |
            dependencies
            automated

# Weekly update for the nixpkgs flake input. Opens a PR only when
# flake.lock changes. Manual runs can be used to refresh on demand.

# Note: PRs created with the default GITHUB_TOKEN do NOT trigger other
# workflows (CI, release, etc.). To get full CI on the bump PR, store a
# fine-grained PAT with `pull-requests: write` + `contents: write` as a
# repo secret named SYNC_PR_TOKEN; the workflow will pick it up below.

  schedule:
    - cron: '23 4 * * 1'  # Mondays at 04:23 UTC

permissions:

  pull-requests: write

          branch: chore/nixpkgs

#!/usr/bin/env bash

SHERPA_ONNX_REPO="k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx"

sherpa_onnx_set_vars() {
    local version="${1:?version is required}"
    local target_arch="${2:-$(uname -m)}"
    local arch
    local suffix="shared-no-tts"

    case "${target_arch}" in
        x86_64)
            arch="x64"
            ;;
        aarch64)
            arch="aarch64"
            suffix="shared-cpu"
            ;;
        *)
            arch="${target_arch}"
            ;;
    esac

    SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION="${version}"
    SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE="sherpa-onnx-v${version}-linux-${arch}-${suffix}.tar.bz2"
    SHERPA_ONNX_STRIP_DIR="sherpa-onnx-v${version}-linux-${arch}-${suffix}"
    SHERPA_ONNX_URL="https://github.com/${SHERPA_ONNX_REPO}/releases/download/v${version}/${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}"
    SHERPA_ONNX_SHA256=""

    case "${version}" in
        1.13.6)
            if [[ "${target_arch}" == "aarch64" ]]; then
                SHERPA_ONNX_SHA256="3a11e89b5a12cd1f8809e385087df7194e8463ab240cf530e5d7cc6d7b27fae7"
            elif [[ "${target_arch}" == "x86_64" ]]; then
                SHERPA_ONNX_SHA256="089c01bded9166ed53f9e433b030863f9dd5ec2ad067dca73a8ba96dca25979d"
            fi
            ;;
    esac
}

# Fetch the sha256 digest for an asset from the GitHub API.
# This is only used as a fallback when the version is not in the built-in map.
# Usage: sherpa_onnx_fetch_digest <version> <asset_name>
sherpa_onnx_fetch_digest() {
    local version="${1:?version is required}"
    local asset_name="${2:?asset_name is required}"
    local api_url="https://api.github.com/repos/${SHERPA_ONNX_REPO}/releases/tags/v${version}"

    curl -fsSL "${api_url}" \
        | jq -re --arg name "${asset_name}" \
            '.assets[] | select(.name == $name) | .digest // empty
             | ltrimstr("sha256:")'
}

sherpa_onnx_set_vars "${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION:-1.13.6}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Update the pinned sherpa-onnx version + sha256 digests across the repo.
# Usage: bump-sherpa-onnx.sh <new-version>           # e.g. 1.12.35
#
# Reads the current default version and per-arch sha256 from
# sherpa-onnx-vars.sh, fetches new sha256s from the GitHub API, then
# rewrites:
#   - scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh
#       * default fallback version (`:-X.Y.Z`)
#       * case-branch label `X.Y.Z)`
#       * x86_64 + aarch64 sha256
#   - packaging/flatpak/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.Addon.Vinput.yaml
#   - packaging/flatpak/ci-manifest.yaml
#       * archive URL (contains version twice)
#       * x86_64 sha256
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
    echo "usage: $0 <new-version>" >&2
    exit 1
fi
new_version="$1"

script_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
repo_root=$(cd -- "${script_dir}/.." && pwd)

# shellcheck source=./sherpa-onnx-vars.sh
source "${script_dir}/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh"

current_version="${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION}"
if [[ "${current_version}" == "${new_version}" ]]; then
    echo "sherpa-onnx already pinned at v${new_version}, nothing to do." >&2
    exit 0
fi

# Snapshot the OLD per-arch sha256 before any rewrites so we can sed-replace
# the literal hex strings without having to parse the case branch by hand.
sherpa_onnx_set_vars "${current_version}" "x86_64"
old_x64_sha="${SHERPA_ONNX_SHA256}"
sherpa_onnx_set_vars "${current_version}" "aarch64"
old_aarch64_sha="${SHERPA_ONNX_SHA256}"

if [[ -z "${old_x64_sha}" || -z "${old_aarch64_sha}" ]]; then
    echo "Could not read existing sha256 for v${current_version} from sherpa-onnx-vars.sh" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Resolve NEW per-arch archive names + fetch digests from GitHub API.
sherpa_onnx_set_vars "${new_version}" "x86_64"
new_x64_archive="${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}"
echo "Fetching sha256 for ${new_x64_archive}..." >&2
new_x64_sha="$(sherpa_onnx_fetch_digest "${new_version}" "${new_x64_archive}")"
[[ -n "${new_x64_sha}" ]] || { echo "GitHub API returned empty x86_64 digest" >&2; exit 1; }

sherpa_onnx_set_vars "${new_version}" "aarch64"
new_aarch64_archive="${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}"
echo "Fetching sha256 for ${new_aarch64_archive}..." >&2
new_aarch64_sha="$(sherpa_onnx_fetch_digest "${new_version}" "${new_aarch64_archive}")"
[[ -n "${new_aarch64_sha}" ]] || { echo "GitHub API returned empty aarch64 digest" >&2; exit 1; }

vars_file="${script_dir}/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh"
flatpak_files=(
    "${repo_root}/packaging/flatpak/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.Addon.Vinput.yaml"
    "${repo_root}/packaging/flatpak/ci-manifest.yaml"
)

sed -i \
    -e "s/:-${current_version}/:-${new_version}/g" \
    -e "s/^\([[:space:]]*\)${current_version})[[:space:]]*$/\1${new_version})/" \
    -e "s/${old_x64_sha}/${new_x64_sha}/g" \
    -e "s/${old_aarch64_sha}/${new_aarch64_sha}/g" \
    "${vars_file}"

for f in "${flatpak_files[@]}"; do
    sed -i \
        -e "s|/v${current_version}/sherpa-onnx-v${current_version}-|/v${new_version}/sherpa-onnx-v${new_version}-|g" \
        -e "s/${old_x64_sha}/${new_x64_sha}/g" \
        "$f"
done

echo "Bumped sherpa-onnx: v${current_version} -> v${new_version}" >&2

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install pre-built sherpa-onnx shared libraries from a local archive or
# from the upstream release after checksum verification (via GitHub API digest).
# Usage: build-sherpa-onnx.sh [version] [prefix] [archive_path]
set -euo pipefail

script_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=./sherpa-onnx-vars.sh
source "${script_dir}/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh"

version="${1:-${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION}}"
prefix="${2:-/usr}"
archive_path="${3:-}"

sherpa_onnx_set_vars "${version}"

workdir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "${workdir}"' EXIT

if [[ -z "${archive_path}" ]]; then
    archive_path="${workdir}/${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}"
    curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "${archive_path}" "${SHERPA_ONNX_URL}"
fi

expected_sha256="${SHERPA_ONNX_SHA256:-}"
if [[ -z "${expected_sha256}" ]]; then
    echo "Fetching digest from GitHub API..." >&2
    expected_sha256="$(sherpa_onnx_fetch_digest "${version}" "${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}")" || {
        echo "Failed to fetch digest for ${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE} from GitHub API." >&2
        exit 1
    }
fi

actual_sha256="$(sha256sum "${archive_path}" | awk '{print $1}')"
if [[ "${actual_sha256}" != "${expected_sha256}" ]]; then
    echo "Checksum mismatch for ${archive_path}: expected ${expected_sha256}, got ${actual_sha256}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -xjf "${archive_path}" -C "${workdir}"

# 修复 aarch64 包缺失头文件的问题
if [[ "$(uname -m)" == "aarch64" && ! -d "${workdir}/${SHERPA_ONNX_STRIP_DIR}/include" ]]; then
    echo "aarch64 package missing include directory, fetching headers from x64 package..." >&2
    # Save current vars
    main_archive="${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}"
    main_strip_dir="${SHERPA_ONNX_STRIP_DIR}"

    # Get x64 vars
    sherpa_onnx_set_vars "${version}" "x86_64"
    x64_archive="${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}"
    x64_url="${SHERPA_ONNX_URL}"
    x64_strip_dir="${SHERPA_ONNX_STRIP_DIR}"

    curl -fL --retry 3 -o "${workdir}/${x64_archive}" "${x64_url}"
    tar -xjf "${workdir}/${x64_archive}" -C "${workdir}" "${x64_strip_dir}/include"
    mv "${workdir}/${x64_strip_dir}/include" "${workdir}/${main_strip_dir}/"

    # Restore main vars (optional but good practice if more steps follow)
    sherpa_onnx_set_vars "${version}"
fi

## 分析结果：`sync-sherpa-onnx` 偶发失败的原因

我通读了 `.github/workflows/sync-sherpa-onnx.yml` 及其依赖的 `scripts/bump-sherpa-onnx.sh`、`sherpa-onnx-vars.sh`，以及下游消费方（ci/release/channels/flake）。这个同步 workflow 的失败点集中在三个层面，按可能性从高到低排列：

### 1. 最核心的隐患：Nix 侧是「尽力而为」，但被当成了硬依赖（耦合断裂）

`sync-sherpa-onnx.yml` 第 64–73 步：

```yaml
      - name: Update flake.lock sherpa-onnx input
        ...
        run: nix flake update sherpa-onnx
```

- flake 的 sherpa-onnx input 指向的是 `xifan2333/sherpa-onnx-flake`（fork），**不是** `k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx` 本体（见 `flake.nix` 第 8 行）。
- `nix flake update sherpa-onnx` 只会把 fork 仓库的 **最新 commit** 写进 `flake.lock`。如果 fork 还没有同步到新版本，`flake.lock` 根本不会反映本次 bump，PR 里 NixOS 侧实际仍是旧版本。这个 workflow 自己也承认是 "best-effort"。
- 历史正好印证：`36cbe2e "refresh sherpa-onnx flake lock"` 和 `b831d13 "bump sherpa-onnx to v1.13.4"` 是**分开提交**的 —— 说明自动化里 flake.lock 那一步经常"没跟上"，要靠后续手动 `refresh`。这正是"有时失败"的典型表现：脚本/PR 正常，但 flake.lock 里 sherpa 版本没动。

### 2. `sherpa-onnx-vars.sh` 的 digest 兜底 + GitHub API 依赖是脆弱点

```bash
sherpa_onnx_fetch_digest() {
    ...
    curl -fsSL "${api_url}" \
        | jq -re --arg name "${asset_name}" \
            '.assets[] | select(.name == $name) | .digest // empty
             | ltrimstr("sha256:")'
}
```

- `bump-sherpa-onnx.sh` 对 x86_64 和 aarch64 **都**强制从 GitHub API 拉 digest（第 45、49 行 `[[ -n ... ]] || exit 1`）。如果新 release 缺某一个架构的 asset（比如 `shared-no-tts` 或 `shared-cpu` 命名变化），`jq` 过滤为空 → 直接 `exit 1`，整个 job 红掉。
- `.digest` 字段是 2024 年才加到 API 的；在 CI 里虽然用了 `github.token`（已认证，配额足），但 `curl -fsSL` 遇到 `403 rate-limit` 或 `503 5xx` 时 `-f` 会让管道 `set -euo pipefail` 直接退出，报错而不是重试。
- 而 CI/验证路径（`build-sherpa-onnx.sh`）里对**已硬编码**的版本走的是 case 分支，不需要 API。两条路径对 digest 的依赖不一致：`bump` 必须 API，`build` 可不走 API。

### 3. 两个架构的 SHA256 硬编码靠 sed 替换，容易"漂移"

`bump-sherpa-onnx.sh` 第 60–79 行的 sed：

```bash
sed -i \
    -e "s/:-${current_version}/:-${new_version}/g" \
    -e "s/^\([[:space:]]*\)${current_version}).../\1${new_version})/" \
    -e "s/${old_x64_sha}/${new_x64_sha}/g" \
    -e "s/${old_aarch64_sha}/${new_aarch64_sha}/g" \
    "${vars_file}"
```

- 每次 bump **只新增**一个 case 分支，但**不删除旧版**（目前还有 `1.13.6`，多了会一直累积）。随着时间推移分支变多。
- sed 靠"旧 sha 字面量 → 新 sha"全局替换。如果某个版本新 sha 恰好撞了别处（或 future 版本里某段的 sha 与旧 sha 部分相同），会发生**错误替换**，产生不可预知结果。
- 只有 `1.13.6` 在 case 里有值：如果上游跳过升级、直接发 `1.13.7`，`sherpa_onnx_set_vars` 对 `1.13.7` 返回空 sha，虽然后面用 API 补上，但 `old_*_sha` 依赖当前版本的 case 值，逻辑链路一断就在校验处失败。

### 4. `create-pull-request` 的前提是干净的工作树（次要）

- 如果 `nix flake update sherpa-onnx` 因网络/缓存/锁冲突而失败，`set -e` 会中断，**但已经写了一半的 `vars.sh` / flatpak yaml 修改留在工作树里**。下次手动跑 `workflow_dispatch` 时，工作树可能不一致。
- PR 用默认 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 创建时**不会触发 CI/verify**；body 里也明确写"只在配了 `SYNC_PR_TOKEN` 时才有完整 CI"。**问题在于**：若没配 SYNC_PR_TOKEN，开出的 PR 是不带 CI 的，只有合入 main 后 `push` 事件才触发 CI —— 届时坏版本已经进了 main。这是"看着没失败、实则没验证"的隐性失败。

### 5. 版本比较是字符串/相等判断（较小）

```bash
if [[ "${current}" == "${target}" ]]; then echo "skip=true"...
```

- **只判相等**。上游 `1.13.6 → 1.14.0` 这种跨主/次版本也能过（不相等就 bump），所以不会卡在这里。但 `current`/`target` 都去掉了前导 `v`，若上游某次用非标准 tag 会偶发解析失败。

content.text:
用 `gh` 查过了，原因已经很明确。

## 结论

**不是 Nix 或创建 PR 偶发失败，而是 workflow 错把上游的非版本 Release 当成 sherpa-onnx 版本。**

最近 100 次运行：

- 成功：50 次
- 失败：50 次
- **所有 50 次都失败在 `Bump pinned version`**
- `Install Nix`、`Update flake.lock`、`Open PR` 都还没有执行

当前 GitHub API 返回：

```json
{
  "tag_name": "tauri",
  "published_at": "2026-08-25T03:44:25Z",
  "prerelease": false
}
```

因为 workflow 使用：

```bash
gh api repos/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/latest --jq .tag_name
```

`/releases/latest` 返回的是仓库标记为 latest 的普通 Release，并不保证 tag 是语义版本。sherpa-onnx 同一个仓库还发布了：

```text
tauri
flutter
xcframework
asr-models-qnn-2
asr-models-qnn-binary-3
v1.13.6
v1.13.5
...
```

workflow 只去掉开头的 `v`，所以会把 `tauri` 当成版本：

```text
bash scripts/bump-sherpa-onnx.sh "tauri"
```

随后构造：

```text
sherpa-onnx-vtauri-linux-x64-shared-no-tts.tar.bz2
```

并请求不存在的 API tag：

```text
/releases/tags/vtauri
```

最终日志：

```text
Fetching sha256 for sherpa-onnx-vtauri-linux-x64-shared-no-tts.tar.bz2...
curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 404
Process completed with exit code 4.
```

最新失败：

- https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput/actions/runs/33185215421

## 为什么表现为“有时候失败”

取决于上游最近发布的 Release 类型：

| 时间段 | `/releases/latest` 返回 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 6 月 19–29 日 | `asr-models-qnn-2` | 连续失败 |
| 7 月 9–30 日 | `asr-models-qnn-binary-3` | 连续失败 |
| 7 月 31–8 月 10 日 | `xcframework` | 连续失败 |
| 8 月 11 日 | `flutter` | 失败 |
| 8 月 12 日以后 | `v1.13.5` | 成功 |
| 8 月 19 日以后 | `v1.13.6` | 成功 |
| 8 月 25 日以后 | `tauri` | 连续失败 |

例如 8 月 19 日成功同步 `1.13.6`：

```text
Bumped sherpa-onnx: v1.13.5 -> v1.13.6
Created pull request #124
```

## 次要隐患

`sherpa_onnx_fetch_digest()` 使用裸 `curl` 请求 GitHub API：

```bash
curl -fsSL "${api_url}"
```

`Bump pinned version` 步骤没有把 token 用作 Authorization，因此这是未认证请求，会受到共享 runner IP 的 60 次/小时限制。可能产生真正的偶发 403。

最近 100 次里有一次 5 月 21 日的旧失败日志已被 GitHub 删除，无法确认是否属于这个问题；其余 49 次都能对应到非版本 tag。

## 后续修复方向

优先级应当是：

1. 不使用 `/releases/latest`。
2. 从 releases 列表筛选严格匹配 `^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$` 的 tag。
3. 在执行 bump 前再次校验目标版本格式。
4. 最好同时确认目标 Release 包含 x64 和 aarch64 所需资产。
5. digest API 请求使用认证 token，并增加重试。

目前没有修改任何代码。
那我们可以先获取 tag 只有是版本 tag 才执行后面的步骤，先不要写代码，给出修改逻辑和代码示例，我同意后在修改

可以。建议不要仅校验 `/releases/latest` 后跳过，而是：

> 获取 Release 列表 → 过滤严格版本 tag → 选择最高版本 → 再执行后续步骤。

否则当前 `/releases/latest = tauri` 时直接跳过，可能漏掉下面已有的 `v1.13.6`。

## 推荐逻辑

1. 手动输入：
   - 去掉可选的前导 `v`
   - 必须匹配 `X.Y.Z`
